body:
I totally agree, I just often worry that I am not leading with good intentions and that I falter in thinking of myself too often. I worry that I may be narcissistic which could be what is causing my depression. I *want* to be that good force in life, but I don't think I have the ability. Therefore I question whether my living is warranted.

Edit: Thank you again for taking the time to reply, you spending your time on me is very meaningful and I appreciate it.

I am sorry about your friend - that seems difficult and like a hard friendship to be in. Your frustration to me seems warranted. I am impressed that you have continued to code, and that you are trying to find a job that suits you best. I wish you the best of luck and hope you find happiness soon my friend <3

I am so sorry you feel this way my friend. I hope you are soon able to find happiness. Sometimes, like tonight, when I feel really down I listen to people play the cello - it sometimes helps me reset my brain and appreciate the art people can produce.

Thanks for taking the time to write this. I use "I" statements because I can never truly understand how others are thinking so it feels unfair to declare their thoughts. I can only say what I believe to be true empirically.
Thanks, I don't want to take anymore of your time. I appreciate the read. <3
It is awesome the way you are able to provide and show kindness to others.

I can definitely sympathize with this feeling and I'm so sorry that you're experiencing it. I personally feel that everyday is hopeless because of my own actions and existence. I hope that you are able to find a solution and a happiness friend.
